meta.title: Vietnam Trip Cost From India 2026 | Flights, Hotels, Food & Complete Budget
meta.description:
Download Free Vietnam Itinerary: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nc8PnpGlxFzPRxX-tYtIv6CVejN1EK24/view?usp=share_link
Planning a Vietnam trip from India? In this video, I break down the realistic cost of a 7–8 day Vietnam trip covering everything from flights and visa to hotels, food, local transport, internal flights and sightseeing.
I travelled across Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang and Hanoi, so this is based on actual on-ground experience rather than just an online budget estimate.
In this video we cover:
✈️ India to Vietnam flight cost
🛂 Vietnam visa cost
🏨 Hotels & hostels
🍜 Food expenses
🚕 Local transportation
✈️ Internal flights
🎟️ Tours & sightseeing
💰 Overall Vietnam trip budget
🇹🇭 And how the value compares with what Thailand travellers may be used to
If you're someone who normally travels to Thailand and you're considering Vietnam as your next Southeast Asian destination, this should give you a realistic idea of how much money you actually need.
I’ll also be back in Thailand from 16 October covering Pattaya, Bangkok, Koh Samui, Krabi and Phuket — so there’s a lot of fresh Thailand content coming.
🌏 Travel In Style
Website: www.utravelinstyle.com
